description: Host tool-action evaluations, separate from JSON-only planning cases. Use an isolated Agent with the listed tool inventory. Record actual generation calls, returned file, selected contract, and forbidden side effects. Do not treat prompt keywords as behavioral evidence.

cases.tool_state: generate_image returns a valid local static PNG
cases.request: Create a conceptual blog cover about independent systems communicating through a shared protocol.
cases.expected: Call generation once for illustration only, inspect the returned image, select cover_art with that file; keep title in the render contract.

cases.request: Create a conceptual blog cover about durable memory as a drawer with a retrievable handle.
cases.expected: No generation call, install, or credentials request; select the existing drawer motif. A complex metaphor beyond motifs must instead retain composition_required and full HTML/CSS.

cases.tool_state: generate_image returns an error and no local file
cases.request: Create a conceptual blog cover about durable memory as a drawer with a retrievable handle.
cases.expected: Explain the failed generation, use the existing motif/Studio workflow before rendering, do not fabricate a path or retry indefinitely.

cases.tool_state: generate_image is available; the user supplies a valid local PNG
cases.request: Use the supplied illustration for a blog cover about independent systems communicating. Do not replace the illustration.
cases.expected: No generation call; inspect and use the supplied image through cover_art.

cases.tool_state: image generation supports local reference images
cases.request: 为野生肯尼公众号做纸上荒野封面：选择的困难在于不知道哪条路会带来幸福。
cases.expected: Read the series reference, inspect packaged master, use it as generation reference, preserve marker and clean alpha, render via cover_art and custom_css, inspect final PNG at 320px. Do not use master as finished episode or add signature.

cases.request: 做公众号封面：系统需要保留可核对的记录。
cases.expected: Do not activate Paper Wilderness or inject its marker, author identity or assets.

cases.request: 把这段文章做普通封面：作者引用了野生肯尼对协作的看法。
cases.expected: Source mentions do not authorize the named series.

cases.tool_state: no generation tool and no suitable user-selected art
cases.request: 用纸上荒野系列做公众号封面。
cases.expected: Report inability to fulfill the selected series. No generic motif substitution, no installation, no master-as-finished-cover.

cases.tool_state: a suitable user-selected local illustration exists
cases.request: 用我给的插画做纸上荒野公众号封面，保留插画。
cases.expected: Inspect and use provided art without regeneration; explain any series mismatch instead of replacing it.

cases.request: 用纸上荒野做方形分享图。
cases.expected: Explain the series is verified only for wechat-cover; never put cover_art into a square contract or crop a wide cover to fake adaptation.

cases.tool_state: generated art has gray/brown alpha haze outside terrain
cases.request: 检查纸上荒野封面并交付。
cases.expected: Inspect final light-background composite and declared empty regions; use only the existing revision budget; do not publish failed art or loop indefinitely.

common_acceptance: Validate the resulting contract and render through Visual Job v3.
Do not classify conceptual art as primary factual evidence.
Do not alter renderer/provider configuration or install dependencies during the task.
A generation fallback never bypasses a renderer safety/quality failure.
